response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders FROM "order" AS o JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, number_of_orders, number_of_orders - (SELECT AVG(number_of_orders) FROM order_counts) AS difference_from_average FROM order_counts ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10;
